run_fuse_gmock: run fuse_gmock_files.py to fuse Google Mock and Google Test source code into three output files
fuse_gmock_h: fuse all gmock header files recursively into a single gmock/gmock.h output file
fuse_gmock_gtest_all_cc: fuse gtest-all.cc and gmock-all.cc into a single gmock-gtest-all.cc output file
validate_gmock_root_dir: validate that the given gmock root directory contains the required seed files
get_gtest_root_dir: get the googletest root directory path relative to the given gmock root directory
